items.name: Birdwatching
items.text: Walk quiet trails at sunrise with a naturalist and spot rare birds you will not see anywhere else.

items.name: Nature & Adventure
items.text: Hikes, viewpoints and hidden waterfalls, led by guides who know every path and every shortcut.

items.name: Cruise Boat Excursions
items.text: Cross the bay to quiet islands and white-sand beaches, with lunch and swimming stops on the way.

items.name: Catamaran Cruise
items.text: Sail in comfort along the coast, snorkel in clear water and watch the sunset from the deck.

items.name: Wildlife & Flora Discovery
items.text: Meet lemurs, chameleons and orchids in the wild, with a guide who explains what you are seeing.

faqs.q: Can I book just one activity?
faqs.a: Yes. You can book a single activity or combine several in one stay. We help you plan the order and the timing.

faqs.q: Are the activities suitable for children?
faqs.a: Most of them are. Birdwatching, boat excursions and wildlife walks work well for families. Tell us the ages and we adapt the plan.
Comfortable shoes, a hat, sunscreen and a bottle of water. For sea activities, bring a swimsuit and a towel. We send a detailed list after booking.

faqs.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faqs.a: Safety comes first. If conditions are not right, we move your activity to another day or offer a refund.
Yes. Binoculars, life jackets and snorkeling gear are provided on the activities that need them.

title: Do More Than Look
intro: Birds at sunrise, a catamaran at sunset and a jungle walk in between. Pick your favorites and we organize everything.
